photo.label: Photo position
photo.note: Where the photograph sits against the page's title. On a phone it always comes first, above the words.

end.label: Photo on the right
end.note: The words first, then the photograph. The default.

start.label: Photo on the left
start.note: The photograph first, then the words. Use it to swap sides with a photograph further down the page.

behind.label: Photo behind the words
behind.note: The photograph fills the band and the words sit on a panel in front of it. For a photograph that works as a backdrop, with its subject away from the left, where the panel sits.

ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour behind this section, and behind the words' panel when the photograph is behind them. Change it between one section and the next so the page reads as bands instead of one flat colour.

plain.label: Default
plain.note: The page's own background colour. Quiet, and the right choice for most pages.

soft.label: Light
soft.note: A soft tint, to set the opener apart from the section under it.

brand.label: Brand colour
brand.note: Your brand colour, with text chosen to stay readable on it. Best used once or twice a page, not on everything.

deep.label: Dark
deep.note: A dark band. The boldest option, and the one that loses its impact if you use it more than once.

motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves as the visitor reaches it. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The section is simply there when the visitor arrives, which is the default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: The photograph shows from the first moment and drifts slowly into place over five seconds as the page opens, once, then holds still.
